name: thoughtloop
description: Adaptive deliberate problem solving for coding agents: search when useful, decide with tradeoffs, execute economically, prove with evidence, and optionally delegate bounded work to subagents.

interface.shortDescription: Think wider. Build better. Prove it.
interface.longDescription: A composable Codex skill pack for deliberate problem solving. ThoughtLoop adapts search and verification to the task, challenges assumptions before commitment, executes economically, verifies with independent evidence, and optionally uses bounded fresh-context subagents when the accuracy benefit justifies the cost.
defaultPrompt: Use ThoughtLoop to search only when alternatives matter, select deliberately, execute economically, and independently prove the result.
When explicitly requested, use bounded fresh-context subagents for independent search or review while keeping decisions and final synthesis in the parent.
